activity_data_retention_period_days.description: Number of days of activity data that must be retained. If not specified, retentionPeriodDays will be used. Set to 0 to turn off the activity data.

dataset_config_id.description: The user-defined ID of the DatasetConfig
dataset_config_id.rationale: The dataset configuration ID is used only for identification purposes and does not affect security controls or permissions.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: An optional user-provided description for the dataset configuration with a maximum length of 256 characters.
description.rationale: The description field is informational only and does not influence security behaviour or access management.

include_newly_created_buckets.description: If set to true, the request includes all the newly created buckets in the dataset that meet the inclusion and exclusion rules.
include_newly_created_buckets.rationale: Boolean controlling whether buckets created after the dataset config are auto-included when they match the inclusion/exclusion rules. This scopes what an inventory dataset observes; it neither grants access nor exposes data, so it is a team data-management choice rather than a structural security control, and 'manual review first' is a process preference, not an enforceable platform policy.

link_dataset.description:
A boolean terraform only flag to link/unlink dataset.

Setting this field to true while creation will automatically link the created dataset as an additional functionality.
-> **Note** A dataset config resource can only be destroyed once it is unlinked,
so users must set this field to false to unlink the dataset and destroy the dataset config resource.
link_dataset.rationale: A Terraform-only flag that links/unlinks the created dataset for additional functionality. It is an operational wiring toggle that does not control access, encryption, or exposure, so constraining it does not improve security; 'enable only after approval' is a process preference, not a structural control.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

organization_number.description:
Organization resource ID that the source projects should belong to.
Projects that do not belong to the provided organization are not considered when creating the dataset.
organization_number.rationale: This value is mainly used for organisational filtering and does not directly introduce a security risk.

organization_scope.description: Defines the options for providing a source organization for the DatasetConfig.
organization_scope.rationale: Boolean selecting whether the dataset config sources from the whole organization rather than specific projects/folders. This sets the breadth of inventory observation and is governed by the IAM the config's identity actually holds, not by this flag; the scope choice is an organisational/data-management decision and 'requires approval' is a process preference rather than an enforceable structural control.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument specifies the project context only and does not directly introduce security risks or enforce security controls.

retention_period_days.description: Number of days of history that must be retained.
retention_period_days.rationale: This setting controls operational data retention duration and does not directly impact authentication, authorisation, or access security.

exclude_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Defined the options for excluding cloud storage buckets for the DatasetConfig.

exclude_cloud_storage_buckets.cloud_stor.description: The list of cloud storage buckets/bucket prefix regexes to exclude in the DatasetConfig.

The list of cloud storage bucket names to exclude in the DatasetConfig.
Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

The list of regex patterns for bucket names matching the regex.
Regex should follow the syntax specified in google/re2 on GitHub.
Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

exclude_cloud_storage_locations.description: Defines the options for excluding cloud storage locations for the DatasetConfig.

exclude_cloud_storage_locations.location.description: The list of cloud storage locations to exclude in the DatasetConfig.
exclude_cloud_storage_locations.location.rationale: This setting is used for filtering excluded storage locations and does not directly affect security enforcement or permissions.

identity.type.description: Type of identity to use for the DatasetConfig. Possible values: ["IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_CONFIG", "IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_PROJECT"]
identity.type.rationale: Selects the identity model for the dataset config (IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_CONFIG vs IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_PROJECT). Both options use Google-managed service identities; this chooses how the identity is shared, not whether an identity or its permissions exist, and the actual privilege is bounded by IAM grants made elsewhere. Picking an identity-sharing model is an operational choice rather than a structural platform security control.

include_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Defines the options for including cloud storage buckets for the DatasetConfig.

include_cloud_storage_buckets.cloud_stor.description: The list of cloud storage buckets/bucket prefix regexes to include in the DatasetConfig.

The list of cloud storage bucket names to include in the DatasetConfig.
Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

The list of regex patterns for bucket names matching the regex.
Regex should follow the syntax specified in google/re2 on GitHub.
Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

include_cloud_storage_locations.description: Defines the options for including cloud storage locations for the DatasetConfig.

include_cloud_storage_locations.location.description: The list of cloud storage locations to include in the DatasetConfig.
include_cloud_storage_locations.location.rationale: Lists the Cloud Storage locations included in the dataset config. This is the sanctioned data-residency archetype: a policy should constrain it to an approved-region whitelist so monitored data stays within permitted regions. The allowed set must be parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable) and must not be pinned to one specific country in the policy intent.

source_folders.description: Defines the options for providing source folders for the DatasetConfig.

source_folders.folder_numbers.description: The list of folder numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
source_folders.folder_numbers.rationale: Folder numbers are administrative identifiers used for selecting resources and do not directly affect security controls.

source_projects.description: Defines the options for providing source projects for the DatasetConfig.

source_projects.project_numbers.description: The list of project numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
source_projects.project_numbers.rationale: Project numbers are used for identifying source resources and do not directly impact security policies or access management.
